language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change this later in the menu.
home.subtitle: Pick a video, choose the song, and AI adds timed lyrics. Style the words, then export a finished video.
about.title: About
about.copy1: AI LyricVid overlays timed lyrics on a video. Pick a clip, search a song, style the words, then export a finished MP4 to your gallery.
about.copy2: Editing and export stay on this device. Detect song sends a short audio clip to AudD to identify the track. No account is required.
editor.title: Lyric editor
detect.title: Detect song?
detect.body: Identify this video’s audio and load lyrics automatically?
detect.noLyricsBody: {{artist}} — {{title}} was recognized, but LRCLIB has no lyrics. Use Search lyrics to try another match.
detect.failFallback: Try Detect from audio in Search lyrics.
detect.needsBuild: Song detection needs the AI LyricVid app build so it can cut a short audio clip. Expo Go cannot do this.
detect.unrecognized: AudD did not recognize this clip. Try another point in the video, or search by name.
detect.noToken: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_AUDD_API_TOKEN in .env to enable song detection.
media.photoPermission: Photo library permission is required to pick a video.
search.rateLimit: LRCLIB rate limit hit. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
lyrics.synced: Full synced lyrics loaded. Tap a line to jump there.
lyrics.beyondVideo: Showing the whole song. Preview and export stop at the video end; later lines stay in the list for editing.
lyrics.cannotSplitBody: This line needs at least two words.
lyrics.startFromBody: Delete every line above this one and shift times so it starts at 00:00.00.
lyrics.pastePlaceholder: Paste LRC or plain lyrics in any language
lyrics.warningPaste: Pasted as unsynced lyrics. Timestamps follow the song, not the video length.
lyrics.warningUnsynced: Only unsynced lyrics were found. Timestamps were spread evenly — adjust them in the list.
lyrics.warningNone: No lyrics were attached to this result.
search.title: Find lyrics
search.needVideo: Pick a video first to detect the song from its soundtrack.
search.noMatches: No matches on LRCLIB. Try a different title or add the artist.
search.pickSong: Pick the song. The editor will list its full lyrics, even if the video is shorter.
search.detectNeedVideo: Pick a video first, then detect the song from its audio.
search.detectNoLyrics: AudD found {{artist}} — {{title}}, but LRCLIB has no lyrics. Search with a different spelling, or paste lyrics.
search.footerDetect: Detect sends a short audio clip to AudD, then loads lyrics from LRCLIB.
search.footerLrc: Lyrics via LRCLIB · any language, shown as published
split.title: Split line
split.help: Tap the last word that should stay on this line. The rest becomes a new line under it.
split.needWords: This line needs at least two words to split.
sync.title: Timing offset
sync.help: Shift every line together if the lyrics start a little early or late compared with the video.
sync.unsynced: These lyrics are not line-synced. Use the offset plus per-line timestamps in Lyrics.
audio.keepHelp: Preview uses the audio already on the video ({{duration}}).
audio.replaceHelp: Pick an mp3 or wav. Preview and export stop at the video length ({{duration}}).
style.hint: Drag the lyric box on the video to reposition it.
stage.placeholder: Search a song to overlay lyrics
export.readyShare: {{filename}} is ready. Use the system sheet to save or share it.
export.hiresBody: This audio is Hi-Res. Choose a lo-res file (44.1 or 48 kHz), then export again.
export.expoGo: Open the AI LyricVid app from the Android/iOS build to export. Expo Go cannot create a finished MP4.
export.noStorage: App storage is not available on this device.
export.copyFailed: Could not copy the video into app storage for export.
export.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device.
export.alreadyOnDevice: This video is already on your device. Save the subtitle files and name them to match the video.
export.needsBuild: Finished video export needs the AI LyricVid app build. Expo Go cannot burn lyrics into an MP4. Open the AI LyricVid app installed from the Android/iOS build, then export again.
update.title: Version {{version}} is ready
update.defaultMessage: A newer version of AI LyricVid is available.
update.manifestMissing: Update manifest is missing a latest version.
update.storeFailed: Could not open the store listing.
